records.claim: Diphenhydramine passes into breastmilk in small amounts. This medication can cause sleepiness in adults as well as the nursing baby. Two studies reported irritability and changes in sleep patterns in breastfed babies exposed to antihistamines, including diphenhydramine. Short-term or occasional use of diphenhydramine is not expected to increase the chance of side effects. If you suspect the baby has any symptoms (irritability, changes in sleep patterns), contact the child’s healthcare provider. If you need to take an antihistamine regularly, talk with your healthcare provider about which medication is best for you. Be sure to talk to your healthcare provider about all your breastfeeding questions.
